title: Claim-Free Discount on the LandlordGuard Pay-Off
content:
**Terms.** The claim-free discount on a LandlordGuard Dwelling Fire Policy pay-off counts claims reported on the policy with a loss date in the tier's claims lookback (36 calendar months on every tier) up to the pay-off date: none gives 2 percent; exactly one gives 1 percent; two or more give 0 percent.

The discount is taken off the pay-off percentage, which is applied once to the unbilled premium of the current term.

| Claims reported on the policy with a loss date in the 36 calendar months up to the pay-off date | Claim-free discount |
|---|---|
| none | 2 percent |
| exactly 1 | 1 percent |
| 2 or more | 0 percent |

## What is counted

Every claim reported on this policy counts, whatever its cause and whether or not it was paid, placed in the window by its date of loss.

## Hypothetical claim files

| Claims on the policy | Discount |
|---|---|
| none ever reported | 2 percent |
| one with a loss date 10 months before the pay-off date | 1 percent |
| one 10 months and one 30 months before | 0 percent |
| one with a loss date 40 months before | 2 percent |
